justification: Inspected byte-buddy-benchmark/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/benchmark/runner/QuickRunner.java and package-info.java. QuickRunner is the only class in the package, and rg found no other source file importing or referencing net.bytebuddy.benchmark.runner. It depends outward on five net.bytebuddy.benchmark classes plus org.openjdk.jmh.runner types, so the package has outgoing dependencies but no observed incoming dependencies in the repo; that makes it an unstable leaf/launcher package, not a stable package depending on less-stable ones.
